messages.offline.for_tool: {what} needs internet, and we're offline right now.
messages.offline.generic: We're offline right now — that feature is temporarily unavailable. Local commands still work.
messages.voicemail.saved: Got it — your message for {to} is saved.
messages.voicemail.unknown_recipient: I don't know anyone here by the name «{to}».
messages.voicemail.save_failed: I couldn't save the message — try again in a moment.

{content}

messages.llm.timeout: I thought too long — try a simpler question.
messages.llm.unreachable: I can't reach the language model — check that it's running.
messages.llm.empty: I didn't understand, could you repeat?
